ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
